title: About Website and Join Offer
text:
## About Website and Join Offer
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046838
On this article we show Directory owners how to update the About Website and Join Offer widget that displays on the Homepage.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091179979/original/hZvxCsgo2UimOnqADalTJs49qXHzqLI76w.png?1618175904 | alt: ]
To change this section, please go to:
SETTINGS >> DESIGN SETTINGS >> HOMEPAGE >> Select Content to Display
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12111330380/original/O9lpuZIOnyQ1wnwTIwCkyK8DDlXAsNbNHQ.png?1657163525 | alt: ]
Find the Section spot where the About Website and Join Offer is selected or select this option and click on Edit Settings:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12094094473/original/WGugomvWLqAeWWydgCsFLrPuzQQSTWQRjQ.gif?1623763084 | alt: ]

## Element Background
This setting will change the background of these 2 sections:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12094093514/original/-b4lPBXGN-zauuaMIIYZrvOkVrVmkM5J9w.png?1623762343 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091180021/original/YfJSBp8t6mIl-AjrUssz3WRmZ_2lRJwp4Q.png?1618176106 | alt: ]

## Element Border
To show a border select a different color from the Element Background color:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12094093562/original/GW2t_R6PUGjPmDbHKxOOwdoLxlWO7cwNOw.png?1623762371 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091180051/original/og7cebjC03jr39JQMY9Wq8-RMXLzeAJSMQ.png?1618176235 | alt: ]

Add text for the Title:

## Join Offer Link Text (URL)

[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091180128/original/GZWYAlRb5LlcJThaegbxZAuj2wjick0MTg.png?1618176807 | alt: ]

## Select Link Button Color
Select the color of the buttons:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12091180130/original/pfz8aqZ0YVbADr1mf6Bu8YkrlRuZQHeYBA.png?1618176834 | alt: ]
To select the color of the button please see: Default Button Link Colors .
